#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Seam score of a texture: how much the wrap-around edge differs, relative to an ordinary neighbouring pair.
usage: .venv/bin/python -I tile_check.py img.png [more.png ...]   (run from the project root)
score = mean|left col - right col| / mean|col i - col i+1| over the interior (same for rows); ~1.0 = tiles, >> 1 = visible seam.
"""
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def seam(a):
    a = a.astype(np.float32)
    inner_x = np.abs(a[:, 1:] - a[:, :-1]).mean()
    inner_y = np.abs(a[1:] - a[:-1]).mean()
    wrap_x = np.abs(a[:, 0] - a[:, -1]).mean()
    wrap_y = np.abs(a[0] - a[-1]).mean()
    return wrap_x / max(inner_x, 1e-6), wrap_y / max(inner_y, 1e-6)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
        a = np.asarray(im)
